articles.summary: Patients with restrictive lung disease demonstrate clinically meaningful benefit in FVC and improvements in multiple PROs for 5.0 mg/kg efzofitimod compared to placebo. Company submitted protocol to FDA in June 2026 for planned Phase 3 study of efzofitimod in patients with chronic, symptomatic
articles.title: aTyr Pharma to Present Subgroup Analysis of Phase 3 EFZO-FIT™ Study of Efzofitimod in Pulmonary Sarcoidosis at WASOG 2026
